[[The Shadestone]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Morgriff Shadestone]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Grenth's Footprint]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Blood Magic]])
:Halves casting time of [[Spell|spells]] (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as [[Shadestone]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as it effectively has two [[focus core]]s, "of Swiftness" and "of Fortitude".

==Unique counterparts==
* There are no unique counterparts.

== Similar items ==
* The [[Rose Focus]] is an equivalent focus that requires [[Fast Casting]] instead of Blood Magic.
